tasks.short: Advise business groups on market conditions affecting buying and selling.

steps.what: Clarify the business question, affected markets and decision deadline.
Read market reports, competitor announcements and relevant regulatory updates.

loop.input: Approved reports and public sources scoped by the decision brief.
loop.output: Dated findings with quotations, source locations and coverage gaps.
loop.check: Verify source locations and quotations; manager checks material interpretations and source quality.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass per source; unreadable or conflicting sources enter manual review.
loop.why_not_simpler: Reports express market changes in varied prose that fixed field mappings cannot reliably extract.

steps.what: Combine sales, pipeline and margin exports to quantify exposure.
Write options, implications and a recommended response.

loop.input: Reviewed evidence, exposure figures and the decision brief.
loop.output: Options memo distinguishing facts, assumptions and proposed responses.
loop.check: Trace numbers to the exposure table and claims to evidence; manager checks commercial reasoning.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per memo; unsupported recommendations return to the manager.
loop.why_not_simpler: Connecting varied market evidence to business implications requires contextual writing and judgement.

steps.what: Discuss uncertainty, challenge assumptions and agree the advice.
Circulate agreed advice and record follow-up owners.

tasks.design: Configure a {BI} exposure view using {CRM} and {ERP}, with dated source snapshots in {DOCS}. Bounded extraction and drafting loops prepare a cited options memo; the manager settles the advice through discussion, then {WORKFLOW} distributes the agreed version and records actions in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Internal figures and external reports have different structures, dates and geographic coverage. Writing useful implications requires business context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reporting connectors handle structured figures. AI-assisted coding lowers the cost of small source adapters, while bounded models help extract and draft prose.
tasks.still_hard: Sparse local evidence, conflicting indicators and sudden regulatory changes still require investigation. Forecast implications remain uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising which market signal matters to this business and explaining uncertainty without overstating confidence.

ambition.what: Weekly market-exposure review for the highest-risk product-market combinations.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time assembling briefs and more time testing options with business leaders. They can initiate more frequent reviews; pricing and investment approval rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess source quality and compare evidence across markets.
reach.learn: Sampling limits, comparable market definitions and confidence assessment.

evidence.claim: Funnel supports standardised marketing data and automated reporting; this supports the reporting component, not the advisory judgement.
Coosto supports listening and trend alerts, providing one input to market evidence gathering.
Cited brief generation and the proposed time reductions are design estimates without a matching documented case.

assumptions: This is internal commercial advice, with specialist legal advice sought when needed.
Time shares describe a typical advisory cycle, not measured customer activity.
Build ranges assume existing reporting connectors and include access review and any applicable consultation under national rules.
Use aggregated commercial data where possible; GDPR applies to any personal data.
unknowns: Available source subscriptions and reuse rights.
Whether sales, margin and pipeline records share usable market identifiers.
Who receives the advice and who approves resulting commercial actions.
Whether national rules require employee consultation for the proposed implementation.
research_questions: Which indicators have previously changed a commercial decision?
Can every material briefing claim be traced to a dated, accessible source?
new_work: Review extracted findings and unsupported interpretations.
Resolve mismatched market definitions and reporting dates.
Maintain source access, mappings and briefing templates.
Check whether agreed follow-up actions produced useful learning.

tasks.short: Choose products and accessories for trade shows.

steps.what: Agree the show's audience, commercial objective and display constraints.
Retrieve product specifications, launch dates and sample availability.
Compare candidates against space, transport, power and budget limits.
Inspect samples and assess appearance, demonstration quality and accessory fit.
Choose the display assortment with sales and product colleagues.
Prepare the approved item list, quantities, substitutes and handling notes.

tasks.design: Configure a product-selection view using catalogue and sample records from {ERP}, with venue constraints held in {WORKFLOW}. Deterministic checks flag infeasible combinations and generate a handover pack in {DOCS}; people inspect samples, choose the assortment and approve the pack before event preparation starts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sample availability, product dimensions and event constraints sit in separate records. Physical display quality is poorly represented by catalogue fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured record views and small constraint-checking tools can join existing information cheaply. Template generation removes repeated preparation of item lists.
tasks.still_hard: Sample condition, live demonstrations and last-minute availability still need physical checks. Data upkeep may outweigh savings for very infrequent events.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing which combination tells a persuasive story and works well in a real exhibition space.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time checking dimensions and preparing handovers. More of the event preparation week goes to demonstrations and audience fit; selection and spending rights do not change.

reach.task: Translate a display selection into workable event logistics.
reach.learn: Venue constraints, transport lead times, accessibility and demonstration dependencies.

reach.task: Arrange products into a coherent visual display.
reach.learn: Sightlines, visual hierarchy and product grouping.

evidence.claim: Structured catalogue filtering, constraint checks and template generation are established deterministic patterns; the digest gives no direct assortment-selection case.
Physical sample assessment and commercial assortment selection remain human judgement in this design.

assumptions: Product and event constraints can be recorded as structured fields.
Shipment booking and purchasing are downstream tasks, outside this selection task.
Time shares and build ranges are estimates for a mid-size company.
Access review includes GDPR where contact data is used and any consultation required under national rules.
unknowns: Quality of product dimensions, weights and sample inventory.
Whether existing software already supports the required selection view.
Who approves product substitutions and event expenditure.
Event frequency and likely reuse of the tool.
research_questions: Which previous display failures could a structured constraint check have caught?
Would configuring an existing records view cost less than maintaining a separate tool?
new_work: Maintain sample status and venue constraint fields.
Review flagged combinations and missing specifications.
Check generated handover packs before release.
Record substitutions when samples become unavailable.

tasks.short: Integrate environmental evidence into marketing strategy and activities.

steps.what: Define the audience, proposed environmental message and intended marketing change.
Compile environmental reports, certificates, product evidence and their limitations.

loop.input: Submitted evidence documents and the environmental marketing brief.
loop.output: Evidence entries with product scope, dates, methods, limitations and source locations.
loop.check: Validate required fields and quotations; flag absent scope, expiry dates and conflicting evidence.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass per document; incomplete entries remain unavailable for claims.
loop.why_not_simpler: Certificates and reports describe scope and qualifications in inconsistent layouts and prose.

steps.what: Assess whether the evidence supports the proposed environmental message.
Draft strategy changes, messaging and channel guidance within the evidence boundaries.

loop.input: The brief, approved claim boundaries and brand guidelines.
loop.output: Strategy proposal and message variants linked to approved evidence entries.
loop.check: Require evidence links and qualifications; manager checks positioning, omissions and implied claims.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per proposal; unsupported wording is withheld for manual resolution.
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience-specific wording and strategy implications require contextual language beyond template substitution.

steps.what: Agree positioning, priorities and delivery commitments with product and sales colleagues.
Review proposed public claims and approve wording or require changes.
Apply approved wording to the website and campaign materials.

tasks.design: Keep a versioned evidence register in {WORKFLOW}, linked to source documents in {DOCS}; bounded extraction captures scope and limitations for specialist approval. A drafting loop uses only approved evidence, while people settle strategy and approve public claims. Configured approval flows release approved assets through {CMS} and {MARKETING_AUTOMATION}, with expiry reminders for supporting evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence is scattered and difficult to connect to individual claims. Qualifications can disappear when reports become marketing copy.
tasks.enabler_now: Small evidence registers and document adapters are cheaper to build. Bounded extraction and drafting help preserve source links, while deterministic rules track versions and expiry.
tasks.still_hard: Lifecycle boundaries, supplier evidence quality and implied environmental claims require specialist judgement. A complete register does not establish that a claim is lawful.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing credible positioning and recognising when a technically defensible statement could still mislead an audience.

ambition.what: Provide smaller distribution partners with approved environmental claim packs and evidence summaries.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time searching for substantiation and more time shaping credible propositions with specialists. They can distribute approved claim packs more easily; technical and legal approval rights remain with the specialists.

reach.task: Assess the scope and limitations of product environmental evidence.
reach.learn: Lifecycle boundaries, comparison methods, certification scope and evidence expiry.

reach.task: Explain environmental qualifications clearly in customer-facing materials.
reach.learn: Precise terminology, qualification placement and evidence traceability.

evidence.claim: HubSpot offers branded content generation; this supports drafting capability, not environmental substantiation or legal approval.
The evidence-register design and estimated savings have no direct environmental marketing case in the digest.
GDPR objections to direct marketing, including related profiling, must be respected in downstream campaign activity.
EU AI Act Article 50 contains transparency duties relevant to certain synthetic content; applicability requires review.

assumptions: A sustainability specialist and legal adviser are available internally or externally.
Public wording is approved separately from internal strategy discussion.
Build ranges include evidence-permission review, access and applicable consultation under national rules.
GDPR and applicable EU AI Act duties are assessed; national advertising and employment rules vary.
Time shares are estimates; specialist review remains substantial despite the drafting opportunity.
unknowns: Which environmental claims are proposed and in which markets.
Evidence ownership, completeness and permission to share it with partners.
Applicable sector rules and required claim approvers.
Whether publication controls and document versioning already exist.
Whether national rules require consultation for this implementation.
research_questions: Can each proposed claim be linked to evidence covering the exact product and comparison?
How will changed or expired evidence trigger correction of live assets and partner packs?
new_work: Review extracted scope, methods and limitations.
Maintain approved wording and evidence expiry dates.
Resolve unsupported or conflicting claims with specialists.
Withdraw or update assets when evidence changes.
Review applicable transparency duties before publishing generated material.

tasks.short: Build investment cases for environmental marketing strategies.

steps.what: Define the proposal, alternatives, success measures and investment decision.
Collect campaign results, cost baselines, sales margins and budget availability.
Model alternatives, cash flows, break-even points and sensitivity to uncertain assumptions.
Write the investment rationale, evidence, risks and proposed decision.

loop.input: Validated scenario outputs, approved environmental evidence and the business case brief.
loop.output: Investment memo separating measured results, assumptions, uncertainties and proposed commitments.
loop.check: Insert financial tables deterministically; trace narrative claims and prevent assumptions being presented as measured demand.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per case; missing evidence remains an explicit gap for human resolution.
loop.why_not_simpler: The rationale must connect varied evidence, strategic choices and risks in readable prose.

steps.what: Challenge assumptions, attribution, costs and downside exposure with finance.
Approve, reject or stage the investment against competing priorities.
File the approved case and record milestones, owners and review dates.

tasks.design: Configure feeds from {ERP}, {CRM} and {MARKETING_AUTOMATION} into a versioned dataset on {DATA_PLATFORM}. A deterministic scenario calculator produces financial tables, and a bounded drafting loop assembles the case in {DOCS} with explicit assumptions and evidence links. Finance challenges the case, the budget owner decides, and {WORKFLOW} records the approved milestones in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data collection and repeated financial modelling are expensive for occasional proposals. Demand assumptions and environmental benefits are difficult to substantiate.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable calculators and document templates are cheaper to build with AI-assisted coding. Bounded drafting can turn checked calculations into a reviewable memo.
tasks.still_hard: Attributing demand to environmental positioning remains uncertain. Forecasts cannot resolve weak evidence or disagreements about strategic value.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing credible assumptions, recognising opportunity costs and deciding how much uncertainty justifies a staged investment.

ambition.what: Quarterly stage-gate review of environmental campaign pilots.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time rebuilding financial tables and writing cases, and more time designing tests and challenging assumptions. They can bring smaller staged proposals forward more often; budget approval rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Design a test of demand for an environmental proposition.
reach.learn: Control groups, sample limits, willingness-to-pay research and attribution.

reach.task: Distinguish evidenced environmental benefits from proposed marketing benefits.
reach.learn: Measurement boundaries, substantiation and uncertainty reporting.

evidence.claim: Funnel supports channel data standardisation and automated reports, supporting the proposed baseline-data component.
Deterministic scenario calculations and template assembly are established patterns; the digest provides no direct environmental business-case implementation.
The proposed time reductions and review cadence are estimates, not documented customer outcomes.

assumptions: Finance provides an agreed calculation method and treatment of costs.
Environmental substantiation comes from specialist-reviewed evidence, not from the financial model.
Despite the automate prior, assumption setting, challenge and investment approval remain substantial human work.
Build estimates assume reusable connectors and include access review and consultation where national rules require it.
GDPR applies where customer-level information is used; aggregate inputs are preferred.
unknowns: Quality and comparability of historical campaign cost and margin data.
Availability of credible demand assumptions and supplier estimates.
Required investment thresholds and approval roles.
Existing financial templates and reporting connectors.
Applicable consultation requirements and access lead times.
research_questions: Which uncertain assumption most often changes the investment decision?
Can a small pilot measure incremental demand before the full investment?
Which model inputs can be refreshed automatically without changing approved assumptions?
new_work: Review input mappings and financial model versions.
Challenge demand assumptions and unsupported causal claims.
Maintain financial templates and approval thresholds.
Compare pilot outcomes with the approved case.
Investigate material variances before refreshing forecasts.

role.altitude: The marketing manager moves from assembling evidence and documents toward testing propositions, interpreting uncertainty and coordinating commercial choices. Preparation becomes faster; strategy, public claims and spending retain named human decision-makers.
reach: Market research analyst: evaluate evidence quality and design demand tests.
Sustainability specialist: understand environmental substantiation and its limits.
Event planner: translate commercial display choices into practical delivery constraints.
Technical writer: make qualified claims clear and traceable.
skills_to_grow: Structured data definitions and exception handling.
Reviewing bounded model outputs against source material.
role.ambitious_version: Run a repeatable evidence-to-investment service: identify market changes, test credible environmental propositions and bring staged investment choices to budget owners. Extend approved evidence packs to smaller distribution partners once specialist review and evidence upkeep are reliable.
